Elevation: AB.signature:
div
  div
    strong "Wall AB elevation"
    button "Close"
  div
    div
      button aria-pressed=false
        svg
          polyline
          polyline
          polyline
          polyline
          line
          line
      button
        svg
          circle
          line
          line
      span "100 %"
      button
        svg
          circle
          line
          line
          line
      button "Reset"
      button aria-pressed=true "ID"
        svg
          path
          circle
  div
    span "Estimated Structural Capacity — Wall AB"
    div
      div
        span "Bearing"
        span "81,647 lb"
      p "Across 13 bearing-eligible panel s on this wall — Building Integrity's own first-pass NDS estimate (double stud pack), not a licensed engineer's calculation."
      span "Pending BI Confirmation"
    div
      div
        span "Shear (racking)"
        span "8,147 lb"
      p "Across 4 braced panel s on this wall — Building Integrity's own first-pass NDS estimate (diagonal brace), not a licensed engineer's calculation."
      span "Pending BI Confirmation"
  div
    span "Review Notes — Wall AB"
    p "No notes yet on this wall."
    label "Author"
      input type=text value= checked=false
    textarea
    button disabled "Add Note"
  div
    label "Add Gable End (tiles Gable End Panels up to the Roof tab's own profile height)"
      input type=checkbox value=on checked=false
    button aria-pressed=false "Add Layer"
  div
    span "Stop Wall — Wall AB"
    p "How much of this wall is deliberately NOT built (Tommy: “a stop wall tool so that it is possible to make incomplete walls”). The building's shape does not change — the floor, foundation and roof still reach the full wall line, and the span draws as a dashed boundary with its own dimension. A stop that reaches a corner takes that corner panel with it."
      strong "NO PANELS"
    label "Unbuilt at the start end"
      input aria-label=Unbuilt span at the wall's start end, in inches type=text value=0 checked=false
    label "Unbuilt at the far end"
      input aria-label=Unbuilt span at the wall's far end, in inches type=text value=0 checked=false
  div
    div
      span "Mid-Wall Bond Beams ( ground )"
      div
        button "+ Add Box Beam"
        button "+ Add Big Header (Mid-Wall)"
      p "Splits the row into stacked bands; drag the brown handle to reposition, the green handles to resize its own coverage. Dragging a beam's bottom edge within 3 in of a covered window's own header bottom snaps flush with it — its header then shrinks to fit above the beam automatically. Dragging it (or, for a Big Header, its own top edge — the blue handle) within 6 in of the roofline instead snaps flush with THAT: a Big Header grows to close the gap, a box beam slides up."
  div
    div
      span "Spanning Headers ( ground )"
      div
        button "+ Add Spanning Header"
      p "One header panel sitting ON TOP of two or more panels — the panels beneath are shortened to make room for it, and its own fabricated width is their combined width. It is named from a single building-wide series (H1, H2, H3) with no direction letter, so its sheet states the wall in words and the panels it spans; each of those panels' sheets names the header above it."
  div
    div
      span "Place a panel"
      div role=group aria-label=Panel placement tool
        button aria-pressed=false "Standard"
        button aria-pressed=false "Braced "<""
        button aria-pressed=false "Braced ">""
        button aria-pressed=false "Braced "/""
        button aria-pressed=false "Braced "\""
        button aria-pressed=false "Window"
        button aria-pressed=false "Door"
        button aria-pressed=false "Column"
        button aria-pressed=false "Big Header"
        button aria-pressed=false "Delete"
      p "Pick a type, then click a panel on the drawing below to replace it, or a dashed boundary to insert between. Click the same button again to put the tool away."
  div
    button "+ Add Big Header"
    p "A standalone header + 2 jack studs unit (no rough opening below it needed) — 2 - 4 ft tall, 4 - 12 ft wide, no sill by default. Also reachable by clicking through a standard/braced panel's own type cycle, or automatically when a window/door header's single brace angle falls out of range."
  div role=group aria-label=Roofline anchor
    span "Roofline starts at:"
    button aria-pressed=true "Truss heel height"
    button aria-pressed=false "Truss seat depth"
  p "Ground-floor run shown for reference (cycle panel types in the Wall tab, not here). Toggle "Add Gable End" above to preview a tiled row of Gable End Panels rising to the Roof tab's own profile height."

Membranes.signature:
div
  strong "Wall Assembly"
  p "Check every finish/product this wall assembly actually uses — when several are checked on one side, the perm-rating check below uses whichever is most vapor-restrictive as that side's effective layer. Checking a product with a known coverage rule (Intello, Exto Seal, Tescon Vana) auto-computes how much of it this building needs."
  fieldset
    legend "Interior"
    label "Clay plaster direct-on-straw (paper + lath)"
      input type=checkbox value=on checked=false
    label "Intello Plus (+ furring + drywall)"
      input type=checkbox value=on checked=true
      span "— 2561 sqft ( 1433 wall + 1128 roof, flat plan-view placeholder — not modeled roof slope)"
    label "Exto Seal (window/door sill tape)"
      input type=checkbox value=on checked=false
    label "Tescon Vana (seam/connection tape)"
      input type=checkbox value=on checked=false
  fieldset
    legend "Exterior"
    label "Lime plaster direct-on-straw (paper + lath)"
      input type=checkbox value=on checked=false
    label "Mento (+ furring + siding)"
      input type=checkbox value=on checked=true
    label "Timber board (wood-fiber insulation board, continuous thermal break)"
      input type=checkbox value=on checked=false
    label "Plywood + Adhero 3000 (+ furring + siding) — needed near openings"
      input type=checkbox value=on checked=false
    label "Exto Seal (window/door sill tape)"
      input type=checkbox value=on checked=false
    label "Tescon Vana (seam/connection tape)"
      input type=checkbox value=on checked=false
  label "Season"
    select value=winter
      option "Winter"
      option "Summer"
div role=group aria-label=3D tool
  button aria-pressed=true "Orbit"
  button aria-pressed=false "Edit"
  button aria-pressed=false "Sill & Header"
